# Offline song suggestions

../tools/song-catalog.json is a compact snapshot of recording titles and artist credits retrieved from MusicBrainz and the Collaborative Song Dataset (CoSoD) on 2026-10-15, plus the ten titles supplied by the owner. song-catalog.js contains the same data for offline/file:// use. It is a selected catalogue, not every song in MusicBrainz.

MusicBrainz core metadata is available under CC0: https://musicbrainz.org/doc/About/Data_License
API: https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_API
Downloadable database: https://musicbrainz.org/doc/MusicBrainz_Database/Download

CoSoD (CC0-1.0), by Michele Duguay and collaborators: https://github.com/duguay-michele/CoSoD
Metadata file: https://github.com/duguay-michele/CoSoD/blob/main/Metadata.zip
Dataset paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.05588

Search filters this bundled data in the browser; nothing typed is sent to a service. The CC0 metadata license does not cover the music recordings.
